input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for custom message sender, custom message listener. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Candidate, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Candidate, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
